architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet, ONNX Model Zoo) + 256-unit MLP head

plantdoc_field_test_original_5_crops.note: v1 was 0.615 on the same photos

rice_holdout.note: diseased leaves only; no healthy rice photos in the data

cotton_val.note: same photo collection as training - optimistic

metrics.note: Field figures include AgriGuard's confidence policy and leaf-only health guard. Small field test sets; re-measure on local photos before claiming accuracy.

training_data.name: PlantVillage (spMohanty/PlantVillage-Dataset)
training_data.use: up to 400 lab images per class (14 crops; blueberry and raspberry used as other_leaf) + augmentation

training_data.name: PlantDoc (pratikkayal/PlantDoc-Dataset)
training_data.use: field images, train split; test split held out

training_data.name: Rice Leaf Diseases (UCI ML Repository #486, Prajapati et al., India)
training_data.use: 30 photos per class for training (+8 augmented copies), 10 held out

training_data.name: Cotton Disease dataset (collected by Akash Zade, India)
training_data.license: not stated by the author - research/prototype use only; replace before commercial use
training_data.use: up to 250 photos per folder (+1 augmented copy); val split held out

training_data.name: Fruits-360 (github.com/fruits-360/fruits-360-100x100, Mihai Oltean)
training_data.use: 25 fruit/vegetable crops, studio photos pasted on varied backgrounds + synthetic piles with leaf clutter

training_data.name: Fruits fresh and rotten (Kaggle sriramr, copy at github.com/Bangkit-JKT2-D/fruits-fresh-rotten-classification)
training_data.use: fresh vs rotten apples, bananas, oranges

training_data.name: Potato Disease dataset (github.com/Mukaffi28/Potato-Disease, validated by BARI; Faria et al., IEEE CCWC 2023)
training_data.use: potato tuber: healthy, dry rot, common scab, blackleg, pink rot, black scurf

training_data.name: Greenhouse tomato images (github.com/Daric-Weng/CFD-DETR-Dataset, subset)
training_data.license: not stated - research subset, prototype use only
training_data.use: real tomato fruits cut out from labelled boxes

produce.note: Second brain on the same backbone. 'leaf' = photo is a leaf -> leaf disease AI. Potato tubers get 6 conditions; other produce fresh vs rotten (rot learned from apples, bananas, oranges).
